title: fix(console): rename the timezone-prompt logic module so no module stem collides by case (objectui#12184)
body:
Fixes #12184

Clause-②: no

## What and why

`apps/console/src/pages/settings/` held two modules whose extensionless stems differ only in case: `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.tsx` (the dialog) and `workspaceTimezonePrompt.ts` (its logic), both from objectui#11758. TypeScript tries `.ts` before `.tsx`, so on a case-insensitive filesystem (macOS APFS by default) the import `./pages/settings/WorkspaceTimezonePrompt` landed on the logic file and `tsc` failed. Linux CI is case-sensitive and stayed green.

As triage `6118599573` directed, the logic module is renamed to `workspaceTimezonePromptLogic.ts` with `git mv` (similarity 100%, content byte-identical), and its readers follow. No behaviour, export or i18n key changes. The optional case-collision CI check is not taken: triage ruled that a new gate defaults to no.

## Readers updated

Measured with `git grep -n workspaceTimezonePrompt` on base `26b0bd2`:

- `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.tsx`: the import of the logic module, and the doc comment that names the file ("When to ask, and what to offer, is decided in ...").
- `__tests__/WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.test.tsx`: the import of `browserTimeZone`, `isAdmissibleZone`, `mayWrite` and `promptRecordKey`.
- `pages/auth/SetupPage.tsx`: the import of `browserTimeZone`.
- `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/machineLocaleCensus-9909.test.ts`: the declared-exemption row for `const zone = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;` names the file by path. Only its `file` changes; `expression`, `count`, `verdict` and `reason` stay. The card does not list this reader.

The grep's other hits are i18n key names: `console.workspaceTimezonePrompt.*` in the ten locale packs, the dialog's `t()` calls, and the pending changeset `11758-workspace-timezone-prompt.md`. They are keys, not paths, and stay unchanged. A re-read of `main` before opening this PR found no new reader.

## The stem pin (recorded here, not a gate)

Triage's pin, `git ls-files apps/console | sort -f | uniq -di`, already prints nothing on `main`, because the two paths differ in extension as well as case. It cannot fail. The pin set by the claim `6119202194` strips the extension first:

    git ls-files | sed -E 's/\.(d\.ts|tsx|ts|jsx|js|mjs|cjs|mts|cts)$//' | sort -f | uniq -di

- **Before**, on `origin/main` `26b0bd2`: exactly one line, `apps/console/src/pages/settings/WorkspaceTimezonePrompt`.
- **After**, on this branch's head `5a2a86c`: no output (0 lines).
- **Control**, same run: the same pipeline over `git ls-tree -r --name-only 26b0bd2` still prints that one line. So the empty answer comes from the rename, not from a broken pipeline.

## What this PR does not claim

It does not claim a macOS run. The failure needs a case-insensitive filesystem, and this change was verified on Linux. The evidence that the collision is gone is the pin above plus `type-check` for `@object-ui/console` passing. The macOS reading is the card's own: the reporter measured the same rename on macOS.

## Verification, at head `5a2a86c`

- ① `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2`, through the verify lock: `Tasks: 34 successful, 34 total`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- ② `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`, which echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -b tsconfig.node.json --force`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `tsc --listFilesOnly` shows the program includes `workspaceTimezonePromptLogic.ts`, the dialog, `SetupPage.tsx` and the dialog's test.
- ② `pnpm exec vitest run` on four files: `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.test.tsx`; `setupCreateTimezone-11908.test.tsx` and `authExitBasename.test.tsx` (the two tests that import `SetupPage`); and `machineLocaleCensus-9909.test.ts`. Result: `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 44 passed (44)`.
- **Census mechanism.** With the rename in place and the census row still naming the old path, the census goes red: `Tests 2 failed | 5 passed (7)`, in "no call site passes nothing, ..." and "every declared exemption matches exactly the sites it declares". The census reads files from disk, so the row has to follow the file.
- ③ `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources`, `pnpm check:test-path-roots` and `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers`: exit 0 each.
- ④ `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, `pnpm check:control-bytes` and `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (`VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`): exit 0 each.
- **ESLint, narrowed to the five touched source files:** 5 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, counted from `--format json`. For this diff the narrowing misses nothing. `eslint.config.js` extends `tseslint.configs.recommended` and sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off. No rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. So the diff cannot change a verdict on an untouched file. `pnpm lint` itself runs in CI.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the diff's paths: NOT GOVERNED.

## Changeset

`.changeset/12184-timezone-prompt-module-rename.md` declares `@object-ui/console` `patch`. `check-changeset-presence` counts two released packages, because the census test sits under `packages/i18n/src/`. The changeset declares only the console, as the claim set, because the i18n change is one test row and the fixed group bumps together.

## Acceptance notes

- Nothing found outside this card's scope. At `26b0bd2`, the stem pin shows no other case-only stem pair in the tree.
